campaign_name: PR-PLAY-06 — Structured Opening Output Budget and Contract Efficiency
purpose: Bounded offline repair; no live/connectivity authority. Stop after ZIP.
executive_summary:
Opening-only 3000-token default (hard configurable bound 4096), explicit incomplete-status rejection. Ordinary controlled output 600; aggregate limits and retries unchanged. 58 focused pass; 361 broader pass / 5 entry-reproduced failures. No prompt reductions. Structural-only evidence; live adequacy unproven. No live provider calls. No provider connectivity diagnostics. No model changes.
No response-schema changes. No additional provider operations. No automatic retries.
No unauthorized gameplay-state mutations. No new persistent gameplay structures.
No experimental PR-EG integration. Frozen ATGB baseline unchanged. No secrets included.
No commit or push performed.
